routes.title: Customer order detail
routes.impact: A non-owner viewing another customer's order would expose private order data.
routes.remediation: Enforce server-side ownership checks on every order detail request.

routes.title: Apply checkout coupon
routes.expectedOutcome: Coupons can be applied only when server-side eligibility, expiration, and per-account usage checks pass.

routes.title: Upload support ticket attachment
routes.expectedOutcome: Uploads require owner access to the ticket and approved file validation evidence.
